description: This file contains functions and classes for generating C shim code for PyTorch's AOTInductor fallback operators, including header and source code generation, handling versioning, and managing external dependencies.

classes.name: ShimGenerator
classes.description: A dataclass that encapsulates parameters for generating C shim code and provides a callable interface to generate code for a given NativeFunction.

methods.name: gen_aoti_c_shim
methods.description: Generates the C shim code (header or source) for a list of native functions, including handling of includes, warnings, and code structure.

methods.name: gen_aoti_c_shim_files
methods.description: Creates or updates C shim header and source files for specified backends, managing ABI compatibility checks and file writes.
